app.name: Lesson Planner
app.description: Plan, export and send lesson plans for J+S groups.

common.name: Name
common.unknownError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in with your passkey or get a sign-in link by email.
signIn.passkeyHint: Face ID, fingerprint, Windows Hello or your device's screen lock.
signIn.linkSent: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent you a sign-in link. It is valid for 15 minutes and can only be used once.
signIn.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
signIn.failed: Sign-in failed. After several failed attempts, password sign-in is temporarily locked – the sign-in link by email keeps working.
signIn.passkeyFailed: Signing in with a passkey didn't work. Maybe no passkey has been set up on this device yet.
signIn.linkInvalid: The sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
signIn.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
signIn.inviteOnly: Access by invitation only. Please contact the people in charge at your club.

invitation.title: Welcome to the Lesson Planner
invitation.invalid: This invitation is invalid, has expired or has already been used. Please ask for a new invitation.

passkeyPrompt.title: Sign in faster with a passkey
passkeyPrompt.body: With a passkey you'll sign in using Face ID, your fingerprint or Windows Hello – no password, no waiting for an email. It's also more secure.

account.title: My account
account.passkeysIntro: Set up a passkey on every device you use (phone, tablet, computer).
account.addPasskey: Add a passkey for this device
account.passkeyAddFailed: The passkey could not be set up.
account.removePasskeyConfirm: Really remove this passkey? You won't be able to sign in with a passkey on that device anymore.
account.passwordIntro: Optional. For when neither a passkey nor email is available. At least 15 characters – a sentence of several words is ideal.
account.signOutEverywhereHint: Ends your session on all devices, including this one. Useful if you've lost a device or signed in on someone else's computer.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email address. If an account exists, you'll receive a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for this address, a link is on its way. It is valid for 30 minutes.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.done: Your password has been changed. All devices have been signed out.
resetPassword.invalid: The link is invalid or has expired.

password.tooShort: At least {min} characters. Tip: combine several words into a sentence.
password.common: This password is known from data breaches. Please choose another one.
password.contextual: The password is too close to your name, your email address or the club.

validation.clockTime: Please use the format HH:MM, e.g. 18:00.

validation.durationRange: Please enter a whole number between 1 and 1440 minutes.
validation.imageTooLarge: The file is too large (15 MB at most).
validation.imageUnsupportedType: Please use PNG, JPG or HEIC.
validation.imageUnreadable: The image could not be read.
validation.ageRange: The minimum age can't be higher than the maximum age.
validation.participantsRange: The minimum can't be higher than the maximum.
validation.hostname: Please enter only the server name, e.g. mail.example.ch.
validation.smtpPort: Please choose a mail port: 465, 587, 25, 2525 or 1025.
validation.smtpInsecure: Unencrypted connections are not allowed on this server.
validation.smtpPasswordAgain: Server or username changed: please enter the password again.
validation.recipientsRequired: Please enter at least one email address.

lessons.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? The lesson and all its program items will be removed. The library stays unchanged.

save.conflictBody: Reload the page to see the current version. Your changes from the last few seconds will be lost.
save.finalHint: Final lessons are not saved automatically.

choice.title: Where should the change apply?
choice.body: This program item comes from the library (“{name}”).

choice.asNew: Save as a new program block
choice.asNewHint: The existing program block stays; a new one is created in addition.
choice.overwritten: Program block updated in the library.
choice.createdNew: New program block saved to the library.

library.title: Library
library.dragHint: Drag into a section or tap “Add”.

dnd.instructions: Press space or enter to pick up. Move with the arrow keys, drop with space or enter, cancel with escape.

lessons.reopened: The lesson is a draft again. Changes are saved automatically.
lessons.statusNotChanged: Status not changed, the lesson could not be saved.

preview.saveFirst: The lesson could not be saved. Please check your input.

lessons.deleteSelectedConfirm: {count, plural, one {The selected lesson is deleted with all its items.} other {The # selected lessons are deleted with all their items.}} The library stays unchanged.

lessons.showPast: {count, plural, one {Show # past lesson} other {Show # past lessons}}
lessons.published: The lesson is published and visible to everyone.
lessons.unpublished: The lesson is a draft again and visible only to you.

blocks.title: Program blocks
blocks.intro: Your club's library of games and exercises.
blocks.results: {count, plural, =0 {No program blocks} one {# program block} other {# program blocks}}
blocks.emptyBody: Enter games and exercises once and reuse them in as many lessons as you like.
blocks.noResultsBody: Try another search term or remove some filters.
blocks.usage: {count, plural, =0 {Never used} one {Used # time} other {Used # times}}
blocks.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Lessons that already contain this block keep their copy.
blocks.usedInEmpty: This program block hasn't been used in any lesson yet.

form.teamsHint: No selection = visible to all groups.
form.sketchesHint: Up to 10 images. Sort with the arrows.
form.unsaved: Unsaved changes will be lost. Leave anyway?

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Manage the club, groups, coaches, people and the PDF layout.

club.title: Club
club.intro: Name, logo and defaults for new lessons.
club.name: Club name
club.footerHint: For example “J+S Kids Sport”. Leave empty for no footer.
club.defaultStartTimeHint: Pre-filled for new lessons. Groups can have their own time.
club.defaultDurationHint: In minutes. Pre-filled for new lessons.
club.removeLogoConfirm: The logo will be removed from all future PDFs.
club.readerPdfLimitHint: How many PDFs a person with read-only access may create per day. 0 = none. Coaches and admins are not limited.

teams.title: Groups
teams.intro: Your club's groups, e.g. Kids, parent-and-child or youth. The order applies to all lists.
teams.name: Group name
teams.defaultsHint: Leave empty to use the club's values ({time}, {duration}).
teams.empty: No groups yet. Create the first one, e.g. “Kids”.
teams.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? If the group is used in lessons or program blocks, it will be archived instead: old lessons keep it, but it can no longer be selected.
teams.archived: “{name}” was archived because it's still in use.
teams.privateDrafts: Drafts visible only to the person who created them
teams.privateDraftsHint: Others see a lesson of this team only once it is published. Admins always see everything.

coaches.title: Coaches
coaches.intro: Coaches for “Responsible” and “Coaches present”. An account isn't needed.
coaches.name: Name
coaches.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? If the person appears in lessons or has an account, they'll be archived instead and stay visible in old lessons.
coaches.archived: “{name}” was archived because they're still referenced.

people.title: People
people.intro: Who can sign in and with which permissions. Access is by invitation only.
people.inviteIntro: The person receives an email with a link that is valid for 7 days.
people.linkHint: You can also share the link directly:
people.revokeConfirm: Revoke the invitation to {email}? The link will stop working.
people.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the club? They will be signed out on all devices immediately.

roleHints.COACH: Edit program blocks and lessons, send PDFs
roleHints.READER: View and create PDFs (limited), no sending

tags.title: Categories
tags.intro: Keywords for program blocks, e.g. tag game, ball game, strength or coordination.
tags.name: Category name
tags.usage: {count, plural, =0 {not used} one {in # program block} other {in # program blocks}}
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? The category will be removed from all program blocks.

sections.title: Sections
sections.intro: The parts of a lesson. The three standard sections appear in the chosen language unless you give them your own name.
sections.name: Name
sections.builtinHint: Leave empty for “{name}” in the chosen language.

fields.title: Custom fields
fields.intro: Your own fields for program blocks, e.g. “Source” or “Learning goal”. They appear in the editor and can be placed in the PDF layout.
fields.label: Label
fields.typeLocked: The type can't be changed after creation.
fields.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? If the field already holds values, it will be archived: old lessons keep showing them.
fields.archived: “{name}” was archived because it holds values.

layout.title: PDF layout
layout.intro: How lessons look in the read view and the PDF. The default layout applies to new lessons; each lesson can choose another one.
layout.usedBy: {count, plural, =0 {Chosen by no lesson} one {Chosen by # lesson} other {Chosen by # lessons}}
layout.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? {count, plural, =0 {} one {# lesson uses it and will get the default layout.} other {# lessons use it and will get the default layout.}}
layout.name: Layout name
layout.columnsIntro: Drag fields into the columns or choose for each field where it goes. Widths are relative: a column of 4 is twice as wide as one of 2.
layout.columnLabelHint: Leave empty for the translated default heading.
layout.conditionsHint: Checked details appear in this order. Empty rows stay blank for filling in by hand.
layout.previewWith: With the most recently edited lesson “{title}”.
layout.previewEmpty: No lesson with content yet. Only the headings are shown.

mail.title: Mail server
mail.intro: The lesson planner sends lessons, invitations and sign-in links through this server. Your hosting provider gives you these details.
mail.statusClub: The club's mail server is set up.
mail.statusFallback: No club mail server yet: the server default is used ({host}).
mail.statusNone: No mail server is set up yet. Until then, no emails can be sent.

securities.NONE: None – only for a local test server

mail.passwordKeepHint: A password is stored. It is kept encrypted and never shown again. Leave empty to keep it.
mail.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
mail.passwordLost: The stored password can no longer be decrypted (the server key was changed). Please enter it again.
mail.fromEmailHint: Must match the mail server, e.g. noreply@your-domain.ch. Replies to lessons go to the person who sent them.
mail.removeConfirm: The settings and the stored password are deleted. The server default is used afterwards, if there is one.

test.hint: The test email uses the saved settings and goes to {email}.
test.subject: Test email from the lesson planner
